The shared Lua pipeline provides 22 generator profiles, reproducible PDF/SVG exports, CLI workflows, both native TeX adapters, and a browser editor running the same core.

Stages 00-33 passed. Stage 33 was accepted at e883cf50e2367274d5aa1f0d41b62ff29690930a with all five required jobs and actual native/browser artifact verification.

Stage 34 candidate 5b0e739d2ac7905c555c3a40f2b3501233153df1 adds bounded byte-hash reuse, compensated packing validation, construction-object budget charges and synchronized floral editor seeds. It adds a 27-workload matrix, cancellation/resource checks and real browser responsiveness/cache/editor checks. Native authored/grown seed generation and exact replay pass in Lua 5.3 and 5.4. Earlier local measurements remain bound to their original source versions; the complete local sequence is being repeated against the published code.

Independent Git verification confirmed all 1,245 file objects, 26 binary assets, modes/history and 297 prior issued evidence hashes. Build 63/run 42318922466 is running for this exact revision; all five jobs and downloaded artifact checks remain mandatory before stage 34 acceptance. Stages 35-39 remain pending. Keep this PR draft; no merge, release or deployment has occurred. See docs/project/STATUS.md, STAGES.json and docs/validation/PERFORMANCE-34.md.
